stem:
The table shows the land areas of some states.

Land Areas

| State     | Area (square miles) |
|-----------|---------------------|
| Arkansas  | 52,068              |
| Louisiana | 43,204              |
| Alabama   | 50,744              |
| Oklahoma  | 68,667              |
| Mississippi | 46,907            |

Which comparison of two land areas is NOT true?

options.label: A
options.text: The land area of Alabama > the land area of Mississippi

options.label: B
options.text: The land area of Arkansas < the land area of Alabama

options.label: C
options.text: The land area of Oklahoma > the land area of Louisiana

options.label: D
options.text: The land area of Louisiana < the land area of Mississippi

visual_elements: Table with land areas of five states: Arkansas 52,068, Louisiana 43,204, Alabama 50,744, Oklahoma 68,667, Mississippi 46,907.
difficulty_rationale: Requires comparing numerical values from a table and evaluating comparisons to identify the false statement.
